25530753d450a9efcd314bd472ae304aa8f69cfa.summary: Unit 42 reports that the threat conglomerate Scattered Lapsus$ Hunters, linked to Muddled Libra, Bling Libra and LAPSUS$, claimed to have stolen over 1 billion Salesforce records and ran a data leak site from Oct. 3, 2025. Bling Libra is described as the main extortion actor, operating an extortion-as-a-service model, and it collaborated with Crimson Collective, which claimed a breach of Red Hat. The report says retail and hospitality organizations face risks including identity theft, account takeover and loyalty or gift card fraud, and it recommends secret scanning, zero trust controls and…
